Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Overview of the platform. Stats are cached on the server with `use cache` (cacheLife + cacheTag).

items.bff: BFF auth: tokens live only in httpOnly cookies, every request goes through /api/proxy
items.query: React Query wrapped by makeQuery / makeMutation with related-key invalidation
items.table: URL-synced search, filters, sorting and pagination (useTableState)
items.i18n: English + Persian with full RTL support
items.cache: Next.js Cache Components (`use cache`) + Redis for rate limiting and cache-aside
items.pwa: Installable PWA with an offline fallback
items.mocks: Fake upstream API with MSW + Faker (no backend needed)

Users.title: Users
Users.description: Search, filter, sort and paginate. Every change is kept in the URL.

redis.title: Redis
redis.description: Cache-aside with remember() and rate limiting with rateLimit() (@repo/redis), on the server.

cache.title: remember()
cache.description: Cache-aside: the value is computed once and read from Redis for 20 seconds, by every server instance.
cache.connected: Redis is connected: reload within 20 s and the value stays the same.
cache.disconnected: Redis is not reachable: remember() falls back to computing on every request.

rateLimit.title: rateLimit()
rateLimit.description: A Server Action allowed 3 times per 30 seconds per user (fixed window).
rateLimit.blocked: Rate limited — try again in {seconds} s.
rateLimit.failOpen: Redis is not reachable: rateLimit() fails open and always allows.
